climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Napa Valley sub-area in the northwest of the county, around but not covering the whole town of Calistoga. The name dates to 1857, with first vines planted in 1862.
